PLACEHOLDER CONTENT for layout testing.

A **variable** is a name that points at a value. You create one by writing the name, an `=` sign, and the value you want it to hold.
Once a name exists, you can use it anywhere you would have written the value itself. Assigning a new value to the same name replaces what it holds; the old value is simply forgotten.

items.code:
sampling_rate = 1000
duration = 2.5

n_samples = sampling_rate * duration
print(n_samples)
items.caption: Two variables used to compute a third.
